reason: S1 adds the externally declared entry point meshopt_filterIndexBuffer, but H0 never invokes it. Consequently H0 cannot exercise its vertex-byte equivalence, degenerate-triangle filtering, rotation-preserving duplicate detection, or size/stride parameter interactions. Because this API and behavior are absent from S0, the coverage gap is introduced by the commit.
evidence: src/meshoptimizer.h newly declares MESHOPTIMIZER_EXPERIMENTAL size_t meshopt_filterIndexBuffer(...).
src/indexgenerator.cpp newly defines meshopt_filterIndexBuffer and accepts independent index_count, vertex_count, vertex_size, and vertex_stride inputs.
meshopt_filterIndexBuffer uses VertexHasher and generateVertexRemap, then filters triangles when remapped vertices match and deduplicates TriangleKey values after winding-preserving canonicalization.
H0 calls meshopt_buildMeshlets*, meshopt_partitionClusters, codec APIs, and meshopt_simplify* APIs, but contains no call to meshopt_filterIndexBuffer.
S0 has no matching declaration, while S1 introduces both the declaration and implementation.
recommended_action: Extend a project fuzz harness to call meshopt_filterIndexBuffer with fuzz-controlled valid triangle indices, vertex bytes, vertex_count, vertex_size, and vertex_stride, including duplicate, opposite-winding, and position-degenerate triangles; validate the returned count and destination bounds.
